hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(/\bgh\s+(pr|issue)\s+(create|comment|edit)|\bgh\s+pr\s+review\b|\bgit\s+(commit|push|tag)\b/.test(cmd)){console.log(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',additionalContext:'Load the gitwise:github-conventions skill.'}}));}else if(i&&typeof i==='object'&&!Array.isArray(i)){console.log(d)}}catch{}})"

PreToolUse.description: Load github-conventions for GitHub writes (gh pr/issue create/comment/edit, gh pr review, git commit/push/tag)
